sentences: My spare room used to sound like a bathroom.
I made four fixes over a weekend.
First, I hung heavy curtains over the window.
Second, I put a thick rug on the bare floor.
Third, I filled the bookshelf behind the camera.
I also moved the desk 2 steps away from the wall.
Now my voice sounds close and warm.
